Guide & Academy/BA Lending Academy/Module 5

Module 5 of 11

LMS — The live loan account

The loan after the confetti: ledgers that never lie, schedules that must add up, and money that must reconcile.

Once funds move, the loan lives in the LMS for years. This module teaches the account itself — ledger and balance reconstruction, amortisation and interest math, the payment rails and their reconciliation, and the servicing events (statements, rate resets, prepayment, foreclosure) that define the borrower's experience.

Lesson 5.1 · 18 min

The loan account and its ledger

  • Explain the loan account as an event-sourced ledger
  • Describe the payment-allocation waterfall and why its order matters
  • Understand accounting integration: subledger, GL, interest states

Lesson 5.2 · 20 min

Repayment schedules, EMI and interest math

  • Compute and read a reducing-balance EMI schedule
  • Distinguish flat vs reducing rates and spot the disclosure trap
  • Explain floating-rate resets and the borrower's options

Lesson 5.3 · 18 min

Payments, mandates and reconciliation

  • Describe the collection rails: NACH, UPI AutoPay, and their mandate lifecycles
  • Walk the bounce-and-retry flow with its charges and notices
  • Explain three-way reconciliation and the break queue

Lesson 5.4 · 18 min

Servicing: statements, changes, prepayment and foreclosure

  • List the standard servicing events and their evidence
  • Explain part-prepayment options and foreclosure quotes
  • Describe closure done right: NOC, releases, registry and bureau updates
